description: From the grand venues of Chanakyapuri to the heritage havelis of Old Delhi, we've photographed weddings across every corner of the capital.
Modern luxury venues, farmhouses, and resort-style celebrations — Gurugram offers stunning backdrops for contemporary weddings.
Elegant banquet halls and garden venues make Noida a popular choice for couples seeking a blend of convenience and charm.
From traditional family celebrations to contemporary events, Faridabad's venues offer warmth and character for your special day.
Growing rapidly as a wedding destination, Ghaziabad offers excellent venues with easy accessibility from Delhi.
Sprawling resort venues and modern banquets — Greater Noida is perfect for grand, destination-style celebrations near Delhi.
